network_enforcement: The checker makes no network request. Its fresh Lean subprocess uses the existing pinned mathlib package environment and explicit local compiled dependency paths; it does not update, build, clone, fetch, or mutate .lake.
coverage_kind: evidence reconciliation plus fresh canonical statement elaboration
scope_boundary: This recipe self-tests only the negative release verdict on the current worker snapshot. It verifies structured authority, predecessor receipt boundaries, hashes, open cut sets, source-fidelity debt, and missing release gates, then freshly elaborates Statement.lean. It does not replay the historical snapshot-bound validation recipe, promote provisional exact-root evidence, perform a cold build, establish independent verification, or accept any receipt.
